results.title: The Asian Banker Summit 2026
results.content: Under his leadership, Malaysia has accelerated its national digital agenda through a series of landmark initiatives, including the Cyber Security Act 2024, the Data Sharing Act 2025, and the National Cloud Computing Policy. He has also overseen the establishment of the National Artificial Intelligence Office (NAIO), positioning Malaysia to coordinate AI strategy at a national level and drive adoption across sectors. His efforts have strengthened Malaysia’s role as a regional leader in digital transformation and emerging technologies, including through initiatives such as the ASEAN AI Malaysia Summit. At The Asian Banker Summit 2026, he will deliver the Closing Keynote on “Imagining Malaysia as an AI-native ecosystem”, sharing perspectives on how governments can drive AI adoption across industries, build digital infrastructure at scale, and position national economies for the next phase of technological transformation. He was recently appointed Executive Director of the ASEAN Applied Research Centre (AARC), where he drives regional AI initiatives alongside his leadership in multiple international computational science projects and national AI programmes across Asia-Pacific.
